title: Conscious Hip-Hop
tagline: Rap that puts social observation, reflection, and ideas in the foreground.
summary: Conscious hip-hop centers reflection on social conditions, identity, politics, and personal responsibility. Its artists use the storytelling and rhythmic craft of rap to examine their communities and the wider world. The music spans many production styles, united less by a single sound than by a deliberate focus on perspective and meaning.

pillars.name: Public Enemy
pillars.why: Public Enemy combined dense production and urgent lyrics to make political critique a defining part of their music.

pillars.name: KRS-One
pillars.why: KRS-One built a career around social commentary and education as central themes in hip-hop.

pillars.name: A Tribe Called Quest
pillars.why: A Tribe Called Quest paired thoughtful writing with adventurous, jazz-influenced production and a relaxed group chemistry.
